digest.component_or_area: LLM failure messaging and resolution classification
propositions: When an LLM call is blocked by a content policy (Bedrock Guardrail or model refusal), the operator-facing message incorrectly states 'too large / malformed' instead of naming the actual cause.
The resolution_class CHANGE_INPUT is correct for content filters but the rendered message is misleading because it conflates guardrail blocks with size/format errors.

message_for() must be extended to accept an optional finish_reason parameter and return a distinct content-filter-specific message when finish_reason='content_filter' and resolution_class=CHANGE_INPUT.
Backward compatibility must be maintained: non-content_filter CHANGE_INPUT cases and omitted finish_reason both return the existing generic message.
